rows.ja: 仕入先(半導体・ITメーカー)

companies.name: マイクロチップ・テクノロジー
companies.sub: マイコン・アナログ半導体

relations.text: Microchipの最大の販売代理店はArrow Electronicsで、純売上高の12%(2026年度)、10%(2025年度)を占める
relations.text_en: Arrow Electronics is Microchip's largest distributor, accounting for 12% of net sales in fiscal 2026 and 10% in fiscal 2025

source.label: Microchip Technology 10-K
source.quote: With the exception of Arrow Electronics, our largest distributor, which made up 12% and 10% of our net sales, in fiscal 2026 and in fiscal 2025, respectively, no distributor or direct customer accounted for more than 10% of our net sales.

companies.name: シリコン・ラボラトリーズ

relations.text: Silicon LabsのディストリビューターであるArrow Electronicsが、2025年度の売上高の28%を占める
relations.text_en: Arrow Electronics, a distributor of Silicon Labs, represented 28% of its revenues in fiscal 2025

source.label: Silicon Laboratories 10-K
source.quote: Two of our distributors who sell to our customers, Arrow Electronics and Edom Technology, represented 28% and 21% of our revenues during fiscal 2025, respectively.

relations.text: 同比率は2024年度が27%、2023年度が34%だった
relations.text_en: The share was 27% in fiscal 2024 and 34% in fiscal 2023

source.label: Silicon Laboratories 10-K
source.quote: Two of our distributors who sell to our customers, Arrow Electronics and Edom Technology, represented 28% and 21% of our revenues during fiscal 2025, 27% and 16% during fiscal 2024, and 34% and 15% during fiscal 2023, respectively.

companies.name: フォーティネット
companies.sub: サイバーセキュリティ

relations.text: Fortinetは、Arrow Electronicsを含む複数の技術ディストリビューターと取引している
relations.text_en: Fortinet works with technology distributors including Arrow Electronics

source.label: Fortinet 10-K
source.quote: We work with many technology distributors, including Arrow Electronics, Inc., Exclusive, Ingram Micro, and TD Synnex.
source.note: ディストリビューター経由の取引としての記載です。

companies.name: モルガン・スタンレー

relations.text: Arrow Electronicsが発行体となる1999年11月9日付のコマーシャルペーパー私募契約の当事者に、Morgan Stanley & Co.が含まれる
relations.text_en: Morgan Stanley & Co. is a party to the Commercial Paper Private Placement Agreement dated November 9, 1999 with Arrow Electronics as issuer

source.label: Arrow Electronics 10-K
source.quote: Commercial Paper Private Placement Agreement, dated as of November 9, 1999, among Arrow Electronics, Inc., as issuer, and Chase Securities Inc., Bank of America Securities LLC, Goldman, Sachs & Co., and Morgan Stanley & Co.
source.note: 資金調達のみの関係で、時期は古いです。

companies.name: Agilysys
companies.sub: ホスピタリティ向けソフト

relations.text: Arrow Electronicsは、AgilysysのKeyLink Systems Group流通事業の資産と事業の大半を取得する確定契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: Arrow Electronics signed a definitive agreement to acquire substantially all of the assets and operations of Agilysys's KeyLink Systems Group distribution business

source.label: Arrow Electronics Form 8-K
source.quote: the Company signed a definitive agreement pursuant to which the Company will acquire substantially all of the assets and operations of the KeyLink Systems Group distribution business of Agilysys, Inc.

companies.name: クラウドストライク
companies.sub: サイバーセキュリティ

relations.text: CrowdStrikeは、米国とカナダのArrowのチャネルパートナー向けにFalconプラットフォームを提供する流通契約をArrow Electronicsと結んだ
relations.text_en: CrowdStrike signed a distribution agreement with Arrow Electronics to bring its Falcon platform to Arrow channel partners across the U.S. and Canada

source.label: CrowdStrike の発表
source.quote: CrowdStrike (NASDAQ: CRWD) today announced a distribution agreement with Arrow Electronics, bringing the industry-leading CrowdStrike Falcon® cybersecurity platform to Arrow channel partners and customers across the U.S. and Canada.

companies.name: アカマイ・テクノロジーズ

relations.text: Akamaiは、Arrow Electronicsのエンタープライズ・コンピューティング事業との新たな関係を発表し、クラウドやセキュリティ製品の提供先を広げる
relations.text_en: Akamai announced a new relationship with Arrow Electronics' enterprise computing solutions business to expand access to its cloud, security and application delivery solutions

source.label: Akamai の発表
source.quote: Akamai (NASDAQ: AKAM) today announced a new relationship with Arrow Electronics’ enterprise computing solutions (ECS) business that expands access to Akamai’s cloud, security, and application delivery solutions across Arrow’s growing ecosystem.

relations.text: Littelfuseは、欧州・中東・アフリカ向けの新しい流通契約をArrow Electronicsと結んだ
relations.text_en: Littelfuse signed a new distribution agreement for Europe, the Middle East and Africa with Arrow Electronics

source.label: Littelfuse の発表
source.quote: Littelfuse, Inc ., the global leader in circuit protection, today announced it has signed a new distribution agreement for Europe, the Middle East and Africa (EMEA) with Arrow Electronics Inc ., a global provider of electronic components and enterprise computing solutions.

companies.name: ラティス・セミコンダクター
companies.sub: プログラマブル半導体

relations.text: Arrowの再販による売上は、Latticeの売上高の2009年度で約9%、2008年度で約11%を占めた
relations.text_en: Resales by Arrow accounted for approximately 9% of Lattice's revenue in fiscal 2009 and 11% in fiscal 2008

source.label: Lattice Semiconductor Form 8-K
source.quote: Revenues attributable to resales of products by Arrow accounted for approximately 9% and 11% of Lattice’s revenue in each of fiscal 2009 and 2008, respectively.
source.note: 2010年の古い記載で、Latticeはその後Arrowとの流通契約の終了を通知しています。
source.note_en: Dated 2010; Lattice gave notice to end its distribution agreements with Arrow.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
